user.title: Solarman Cloud
user.description: How should Home Assistant sign in to Solarman?

menu_options.openapi: Official API (App ID + App Secret) - recommended
menu_options.portal: Token copied from the web portal (fallback)

openapi.title: Official Solarman API
openapi.description: Enter the App ID and App Secret Solarman sent you, plus the e-mail and password of your SOLARMAN Smart account. Only a SHA-256 digest of the password is stored.

portal.title: Web portal token
portal.description: Solarman blocks scripted password logins with a slider CAPTCHA, so this mode uses a refresh token instead. Sign in at home.solarmanpv.com in your browser, then copy the value of the cookie named 442287045fabeaa868450dec4baee7f4 and paste it below.

reconfigure.title: Change sign-in method
reconfigure.description: The station, its entities and their history stay as they are; only the way of signing in changes.

menu_options.reconfigure_openapi: Official API (App ID + App Secret) - recommended
menu_options.reconfigure_portal: Token copied from the web portal (fallback)

reconfigure_openapi.title: Official Solarman API
reconfigure_openapi.description: Enter the App ID and App Secret Solarman sent you, plus the e-mail and password of your SOLARMAN Smart account. Only a SHA-256 digest of the password is stored.

reconfigure_portal.title: Web portal token
reconfigure_portal.description: Paste a fresh refresh token, or leave the field empty to reuse the one stored earlier.

reauth_openapi.title: Sign in again
reauth_openapi.description: Solarman rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

reauth_confirm.title: Token expired
reauth_confirm.description: Solarman blocks scripted password logins with a slider CAPTCHA, so this mode uses a refresh token instead. Sign in at home.solarmanpv.com in your browser, then copy the value of the cookie named 442287045fabeaa868450dec4baee7f4 and paste it below.
